feedback.problem: Which of the following intervals is equivalent to ${R}_{0}^{+}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The set ${R}_{0}^{+}$ denotes the set of positive real numbers or zero. It is equivalent to the following interval:

$$
[0,\infty )
$$

The other options are *not* equivalent to ${R}_{0}^{+}:$

- The interval $(-\infty ,\infty )$ includes the negative real numbers.

- The interval $(0,\infty )$ does not include the zero.

- The interval $(-\infty ,0)$ does not include the positive real numbers or zero.

- The interval $(-\infty ,0]$ does not include the positive real numbers.
